description: Emplacement des éoliennes dans la partie belge de la Mer du Nord is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Koninklijk Belgisch Instituut voor Natuurwetenschappen (KBIN). This dataset represents the exact location of the wind turbines in the Belgian Part of the North Sea. Coverage: Koninklijk Belgisch Instituut voor Natuurwetenschappen (KBIN). The portal shows the English title as "Windmill locations" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Koninklijk Belgisch Instituut voor Natuurwetenschappen (KBIN). Its keywords include Gouvernement Fédéral, Reporting INSPIRE, Federale Overheid, Federal government, Marine essentials, Bundesregierung. The listing shows 2026-08-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
